rules.aggregation: Pack-specific and provider-specific descriptive views permitted; paired comparisons require same Episode/cutoff/provider/model and both Pack arms; no provider weighting or winner selection
rules.directions: UP/DOWN/FLAT are actionable; NO_SIGNAL is handled separately by contract
rules.flat: actionable only when realized direction FLAT
rules.missing_outcomes: integrity failure for attached pair; do not impute
rules.no_signal: no_signal_ok compares quiet Outcome condition; horizon direction fields remain null/not applicable
rules.rounding: contract-defined pips rounding to 2 decimals; no unapproved metric rounding defined
rules.unpaired_valid_forecasts: excluded from paired A/E comparison but retained in completeness accounting

secondary_measurement: Immediate Impulse directional accuracy (only when outcome state SUPPORTED; current minute route otherwise NOT_APPLICABLE/APPROXIMATION_ONLY)

supported_metrics.denominator: eligible directional forecasts with valid T+15 Outcome; terminal-invalid and unavailable excluded; no-signal handled by contract
supported_metrics.name: T+15 directional accuracy
supported_metrics.population: valid forecasts with VALID Outcome and non-NO_SIGNAL forecast; report Pack-specific and paired comparisons

supported_metrics.denominator: supported impulse outcomes only; APPROXIMATION_ONLY not scored as strict impulse accuracy
supported_metrics.name: Immediate Impulse directional accuracy
supported_metrics.population: non-NO_SIGNAL forecasts with SUPPORTED Immediate Impulse Outcome

supported_metrics.denominator: same eligible forecast population; T+15 interval distance error and midpoint absolute error are distinct fields
supported_metrics.name: magnitude or pip error
supported_metrics.population: valid non-NO_SIGNAL forecasts with VALID Outcome

supported_metrics.denominator: eligible forecasts per horizon; supported horizons T+5,T+15,T+30,T+60
supported_metrics.name: horizon accuracy
supported_metrics.population: valid non-NO_SIGNAL forecasts with VALID Outcome

supported_metrics.denominator: eligible complete paths; overall_path_score is mean of horizon correctness
supported_metrics.name: path accuracy
supported_metrics.population: valid non-NO_SIGNAL forecasts with complete validated path and VALID Outcome

supported_metrics.denominator: eligible forecasts with reversal field available
supported_metrics.name: reversal accuracy
supported_metrics.population: valid non-NO_SIGNAL forecasts with VALID Outcome

supported_metrics.name: composite score
supported_metrics.population: not authorized unless an accepted governing artifact explicitly selects it
